items.description: A file to store privately and add to a product's digital files. A product that already has a file of that name (without case sensitivity) keeps it, so running the recipe again adds nothing.

ProductId.description: The content item id of the product the file is delivered with. The latest version of the product is updated.

FileName.description: The name the file is stored and downloaded under, such as manual.pdf. Unsafe characters are removed.

Base64.description: The file's bytes, base64-encoded. Takes precedence over Text.

Text.description: The file's content as UTF-8 text, used when Base64 is not given.

Files.description: The files to add. Each must be between 1 byte and 10 MB.
